title: Unqualified conname guard silently skips the migration
expected_feedback: Standard: constraint names are unique per table, not per database. If any other table already carries a constraint named fk_user, this guard reports 'already exists', the ALTER TABLE never runs, and the DO block completes successfully -- the migration reports success having applied nothing. Add AND conrelid = 'public.orders'::regclass to scope the lookup. Scoping by conrelid is necessary but not sufficient: the guard still decides on the constraint NAME. Compare pg_get_constraintdef() as well and RAISE EXCEPTION on a mismatch, or a same-named constraint with a different definition on this very table makes the migration skip and report success.
violated_rule: constraint existence guard scoped by conrelid
